entries.title: Arizona Department of Gaming issues cease-and-desist orders to five online gambling operators alleging felony promotion of gambling, illegal control of an enterprise, and money laundering
entries.facts: On July 10, 2026, the Arizona Department of Gaming announced it had issued cease-and-desist orders to BetOpenly, Bookmaker, Club WPT Online Poker, Kutt Inc., and Raffle Creator, with each enforcement action alleging conduct giving rise to the felonies of promotion of gambling, illegal control of an enterprise, and money laundering. The Department alleges, among other things, that BetOpenly enabled event wagering and daily fantasy sports contests without the requisite state licenses and facilitated availability to underage Arizonans; that Bookmaker facilitated wagering on horse racing, casino games, and sports betting without an event wagering or advanced deposit wagering provider license; that Club WPT Online Poker enabled Arizonans under 21 to engage in pay-to-play online poker tournaments for prizes while using deceptive 'no purchase necessary' language; that Kutt Inc. allowed Arizona users to deposit money and wager on sports, politics, pop culture and casino-style games in a manner providing prohibited third-party benefit; and that Raffle Creator allowed people under 21 to purchase raffle tickets for prizes without meeting Arizona nonprofit raffle requirements. Notified entities are directed to immediately stop all gambling operations and activities in Arizona and to desist from future illegal gambling operations; the Department states future actions may include criminal charges or civil action against entities, principals, and employees, potential restitution awards, and forfeiture of all monies acquired due to the illegal conduct. Department Director Jackie Johnson said, 'Through these cease-and-desist orders we are putting operators on notice: their conduct runs contrary to Arizona law and they must stop promoting illegal gambling.' All conduct described is alleged by the Department and unadjudicated.
entries.source_label: Arizona Department of Gaming press release (July 10, 2026)
entries.relevant_to: sweepstakes and social-casino operators, online sportsbooks, DFS and raffle platforms
